note: Private RV park on Pioneer Rd in Quincy, beside the community park and public pool. Paved, angled big-rig sites under pines; sites 1-30 are the most open for satellite. More than half the sites are let by the month; only the 18 pull-throughs and 3 buddy sites are sold by the night online. Passport America's 50% applies May-Oct weeknights only. --Claude
summary: Rates confirmed on the operator page ($35-70 + tax); 50 A FHU, pull-throughs, showers/laundry/dump/wifi, year-round, Passport America + military discounts, Campspot (180-day window). Long-stay: keep with caveat - 21 of ~62 sites sold nightly online (~34%), 6-8 open on winter/May weeknights. Price gate: posted $35 off-season / $45 peak weekday back-in, but the online pull-throughs are $45-65. Google 4.6 (142).
flags: LONG-STAY (caveat band): Campspot sells only 'Pull Thru 30, 50 amp' (18 sites) and 'Double Site/Buddy Site' (3) - about 21 of the ~62 sites (~34%); both back-in types listed no site on every date read (2026-12-08, 2027-01-26, 2027-05-18, 2027-06-08/12). Open nightly sites on a weeknight: 7 (Dec), 7 (Jan), 8 (May). Operator: 'We encourage long term, month to month tenants', monthly $600-625 + electric, 180-day stay cap ('time restricted park'). Passes tests 1-5 (nightly rates posted, no application for nights, 2-night weekend minimum only, ~34% nightly, not a home community); kept with the caveat that more than half the sites are long-term (new note says so).

PRICE GATE (private): posted back-in 30 A $35 (Nov-Apr) / $45 (May-Oct Sun-Thu), but back-ins are not sold online; the pull-throughs a 23-ft rig can book are $45 off-season and $55-65 in May-Oct (+ tax). Passport America 50% on up to two May-Oct weeknights (operator member discount); military 15%. Not a Good Sam Park; no gateway within 40 km (Lassen 77 km). Borderline in summer; reviewer's call.
